checks.name: correct_target
checks.outcome: The claimed negation is failure of equality along a nontrivial line issuing from the base; isolated contact elsewhere is outside the claim.

checks.name: multiply_connected_green_domain
checks.outcome: The annulus 1 < |z| < e is bounded, smooth and doubly connected.

checks.name: global_single_valuedness
checks.outcome: All cylinder functions are periodic in y and descend to the annulus.

checks.name: kernel_convergence
checks.outcome: Strip summands and every fixed derivative order decay exponentially on interior compact sets.

checks.name: martin_limit
checks.outcome: Periodized Green-function normal derivative equals 2 pi times the periodized Poisson density; normalization cancels the constant.

checks.name: minimality
checks.outcome: Domination, odd reflection, O(1/r) harmonic Laurent expansion, dipole cancellation and the maximum principle force each nonnegative harmonic minorant to be a scalar multiple.

checks.name: all_terms_bound
checks.outcome: S2/S1 is a weighted average of sech((2k-1)pi^2), at most sech(pi^2); no finite truncation is used.

checks.name: rational_gap
checks.outcome: c < 8/83 < 1/10 and 75/664 > 1/10, using elementary analytic inequalities.

checks.name: admissible_competitors
checks.outcome: Four explicit globally positive harmonic functions each equal one at the base; their gradients are (+/-1,0),(0,+/-b).

checks.name: uniform_direction_control
checks.outcome: The maximum of their first-order differences from K exceeds rho/10 for every nonzero direction.

checks.name: taylor_remainder
checks.outcome: A finite common O(rho^2) bound preserves the strict gap on a punctured neighborhood.

checks.name: basepoint_control
checks.outcome: K(a)=H_a(a)=1 is retained, so the argument excludes nontrivial contact rather than automatic basepoint equality.

checks.name: scope_control
checks.outcome: No appeal is made to absence of literature results, numerical tests, a trajectory approximation, or equivalence with symmetric Harnack distance.
